name: Coordinate hands and feet in sequence
short_description: Coordinate hands and feet in sequence once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can coordinate hands and feet in sequence in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Coordinate hands and feet in sequence means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Coordinate hands and feet in sequence in a fresh real-life scenario.
